alternatives.name: DERIVED_AGGREGATION_ONLY
tradeoffs: Derived cross-venue datasets add manifest complexity.

decision.summary: Cross-exchange price and liquidity aggregates are derived datasets with explicit input venue manifests. Venue-native events remain primary; aggregation never discards upstream identity.
decision.title: Cross-exchange aggregation rules

effectivity.non_authorization_statement: Proposed status does not authorize multi-venue ingestion or arbitrage execution.
